subject.title: [Feature]: Control console session list should show full date

question: Should the Sessions `Updated` column switch from relative labels to local full date/time, or keep relative text and add exact time only as hover/detail context?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but this is a product/UX display choice rather than a broken documented contract, and an open conflicting fork PR already proposes one direction.

options.title: Adopt full date/time display
options.body: Use a narrow Control UI change to show local full date/time in the table and preserve relative context as a tooltip or detail where useful.

options.title: Keep relative as primary
options.body: Leave the table optimized for recency scanning and add exact date/time only to hover/detail surfaces.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Decide that the current relative timestamp is the intended Sessions list behavior and close the linked implementation candidate too.

recommendation.title: Adopt full date/time display
recommendation.body: Use a narrow Control UI change to show local full date/time in the table and preserve relative context as a tooltip or detail where useful.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work and review history around Sessions UI and Control UI behavior make this the strongest available routing signal for the display decision.
